2026-10-26 RESOLVED: the Cloudflare Workers deploy failures from #681 (8a22dfb) to 34beed0 were caused by `public/_redirects`, not by Cloudflare settings. Cloudflare counts every rule from the first dynamic rule onward against the 100-rule dynamic limit; two `/products/:slug` rules near the top made 108 rules dynamic and `wrangler deploy` failed with error 100324 (build log 64d38d0b, read via the Builds API). Local builds and `wrangler deploy --dry-run` do not run this check. #701 (eb6c97e, owner-approved) moved the dynamic rules last and added tests/architecture/redirects-platform-limits.test.mjs with a negative proof. Build 7f231a3b on eb6c97e succeeded; production /en/products/vungtaylai/ returns 200.
